SELECT m.id_f, m.formulacao, m.mat, f.d1, f.d2, m.dt, m.saldo
  FROM quimicadb.matprima m
  LEFT JOIN quimicadb.formula f
    ON f.id_f = m.id_f AND f.nf = 'X'
 WHERE m.saldo > 0
   AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.formulacao) ? ("m.formulacao = '" + String($json.body.formulacao).replace(/'/g, '') + "'") : '1=1' }})
   AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.mat) ? ("UPPER(m.mat) LIKE '%" + String($json.body.mat).toUpperCase().replace(/'/g, '') + "%'") : '1=1' }})
 ORDER BY m.dt DESC
 LIMIT 200;

SELECT
       id_f                                   AS codigo_formula,
       formulacao                             AS formulacao,
       mat                                    AS familia,
       d1                                     AS dureza_min,
       d2                                     AS dureza_max,
       CONCAT(d1, '/', d2)                    AS faixa_dureza,
       CONCAT(mat, ' ', d1, '/', d2)          AS descricao_curta,
       -- aliases legados para compatibilidade com consumidores antigos
       id_f                                   AS id_f,
       mat                                    AS mat,
       d1                                     AS d1,
       d2                                     AS d2
  FROM quimicadb.formula
 WHERE nf = 'X'
   -- guarda: se nenhum filtro util foi enviado, nao retorna nada (evita devolver registro aleatorio)
   AND ( '{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.mat) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}' <> ''
         OR {{ parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.d1) || 0), 10) }} > 0
         OR {{ parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.d2) || 0), 10) }} > 0
         OR '{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.q) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}' <> ''
         OR '{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.formulacao) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}' <> '' )
   AND ( '{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.mat) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}' = ''
         OR UPPER(mat) = UPPER('{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.mat) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}') )
   AND ( {{ parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.d1) || 0), 10) }} = 0
         OR d1 = {{ parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.d1) || 0), 10) }} )
   AND ( {{ parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.d2) || 0), 10) }} = 0
         OR d2 = {{ parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.d2) || 0), 10) }} )
   AND ( '{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.formulacao) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}' = ''
         OR UPPER(formulacao) = UPPER('{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.formulacao) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}') )
   AND ( '{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.q) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}' = ''
         OR UPPER(formulacao) LIKE UPPER('%{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.q) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}%')
         OR UPPER(mat)        LIKE UPPER('%{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.q) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}%')
         OR UPPER(CONCAT(mat,' ',d1,'/',d2)) LIKE UPPER('%{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.q) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}%') )
 ORDER BY mat ASC, d1 ASC, d2 ASC
 LIMIT {{ Math.max(1, Math.min(parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.limit) || (($json.body && ($json.body.q || $json.body.formulacao)) ? 50 : 1)), 10), 200)) }};

SELECT ped_mestre, pedido, status, puliq, mat, kt, d, da, cor, queima,
       bl, bl_desba, blpr, blfim, usinagem, usinafinal, usi_ter, usi_stat
  FROM producao
 WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
   AND (queima IS NULL OR queima = 'N')
   AND ((usinagem IS NULL) OR usinagem != 'SIM' OR usinafinal = 'F')
   AND ((usi_ter  IS NULL) OR usi_ter  != 'S'   OR usi_stat = 'F')
   AND ( (bl IS NULL OR bl IN ('','N')) OR (blfim = 'F') OR (bl = 'S' AND bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') )
   AND (UPPER(mat) != 'RETIFICA')
   AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.customer_filter) ? ("UPPER(pedido) LIKE '%" + String($json.body.customer_filter).toUpperCase().replace(/'/g, '') + "%'") : '1=1' }})
   AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.family_filter) ? ("UPPER(mat) LIKE '%" + String($json.body.family_filter).toUpperCase().replace(/'/g, '') + "%'") : '1=1' }})
 ORDER BY pedido ASC
 LIMIT {{ Math.max(1, Math.min(parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.limit) || 100), 10), 500)) }};

SELECT mat, d, da, NULLIF(TRIM(cor),'') AS cor, COALESCE(puliq,0) AS puliq,
       ROUND(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(kt,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3))),2) AS kt_total,
       COUNT(*) AS qtd_pedidos,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ped_mestre ORDER BY ped_mestre SEPARATOR ',') AS ped_mestres,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT idcli ORDER BY idcli SEPARATOR ',') AS idclis,
       SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT idcli ORDER BY idcli SEPARATOR ','),',',1) AS idcli_principal,
       MIN(pedido) AS primeiro_pedido,
       MAX(pedido) AS ultimo_pedido,
       MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(urgente,'N'))='S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tem_urgente,
       MAX(CASE WHEN bl='S' AND bl_desba='S' AND blpr='S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tem_retorno_bal,
       MIN(COALESCE(prazo, dt_entrega)) AS sla_min,
       MIN(dt_entra) AS dt_entra_min,
       DATEDIFF(MIN(COALESCE(prazo, dt_entrega)), CURDATE()) AS dias_sla,
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MIN(dt_entra)) AS dias_em_casa
  FROM producao
 WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
   AND (queima IS NULL OR queima IN ('N',''))
   AND ((usinagem IS NULL) OR usinagem NOT IN ('SIM') OR usinafinal = 'F')
   AND ((usi_ter IS NULL) OR usi_ter != 'S' OR usi_stat = 'F')
   AND ( (bl IS NULL OR bl IN ('','N')) OR blfim = 'F' OR (bl = 'S' AND bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') )
   AND UPPER(mat) != 'RETIFICA'
   AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {{ Math.max(30, Math.min(parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.max_age_days) || 365), 10), 3650)) }} DAY))
   AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.customer_filter) ? ("(UPPER(pedido) LIKE '%" + String($json.body.customer_filter).toUpperCase().replace(/'/g, '') + "%' OR idcli = '" + String($json.body.customer_filter).replace(/'/g, '') + "')") : '1=1' }})
   AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.family_filter) ? ("UPPER(mat) LIKE '%" + String($json.body.family_filter).toUpperCase().replace(/'/g, '') + "%'") : '1=1' }})
 GROUP BY mat, d, da, NULLIF(TRIM(cor),''), COALESCE(puliq,0)
 ORDER BY tem_urgente DESC, tem_retorno_bal DESC, COALESCE(dias_sla,9999) ASC, kt_total DESC
 LIMIT 100;

SELECT ped_mestre, pedido, status, puliq, mat, kt, d, da, cor, kgg, eixo,
       idcli, mat_cli,
       urgente, prazo, dt_entrega, dt_entra, dataped,
       queima, bl, bl_desba, blpr, blfim, usinagem, usinafinal, usi_ter, usi_stat,
       obsped, dc_obs,
       DATEDIFF(COALESCE(prazo, dt_entrega), CURDATE()) AS dias_sla,
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), dt_entra) AS dias_em_casa,
       CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(urgente,'N'))='S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag_urgente,
       CASE WHEN bl='S' AND bl_desba='S' AND blpr='S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS flag_retorno_bal
  FROM producao
 WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
   AND (queima IS NULL OR queima IN ('N',''))
   AND ((usinagem IS NULL) OR usinagem NOT IN ('SIM') OR usinafinal = 'F')
   AND ((usi_ter IS NULL) OR usi_ter != 'S' OR usi_stat = 'F')
   AND ( (bl IS NULL OR bl IN ('','N')) OR blfim = 'F' OR (bl = 'S' AND bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') )
   AND UPPER(mat) != 'RETIFICA'
   AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {{ Math.max(30, Math.min(parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.max_age_days) || 365), 10), 3650)) }} DAY))
   AND UPPER(mat) = UPPER('{{ String((($json.body && $json.body.mat) || '')).replace(/'/g, '') }}')
   AND d  = {{ parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.d) || 0), 10) }}
   AND ( {{ parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.da) || 0), 10) }} = 0 OR da = {{ parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.da) || 0), 10) }} )
   AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.cor) ? ("UPPER(NULLIF(TRIM(cor),'')) = UPPER('" + String($json.body.cor).replace(/'/g, '') + "')") : '1=1' }})
 ORDER BY flag_urgente DESC, flag_retorno_bal DESC, COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(prazo, dt_entrega), CURDATE()),9999) ASC, pedido ASC
 LIMIT 500;

SELECT ped_mestre, pedido, status, puliq, mat, kt, d, da, cor,
       idcli, mat_cli, urgente, prazo, dt_entrega, dt_entra,
       queima, bl, bl_desba, blpr, blfim, usinagem, usinafinal, usi_ter, usi_stat,
       DATEDIFF(COALESCE(prazo, dt_entrega), CURDATE()) AS dias_sla,
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), dt_entra) AS dias_em_casa,
       CONCAT_WS(' | ',
         CASE WHEN queima = 'S' THEN 'queima_pendente' END,
         CASE WHEN usinagem = 'SIM' AND (usinafinal IS NULL OR usinafinal != 'F') THEN 'usinagem_pendente' END,
         CASE WHEN usi_ter  = 'S'   AND (usi_stat   IS NULL OR usi_stat   != 'F') THEN 'usiterceirizada_pendente' END,
         CASE WHEN bl = 'S' AND NOT (bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') AND (blfim IS NULL OR blfim != 'F') THEN 'balanceamento_pendente' END,
         CASE WHEN UPPER(mat) = 'RETIFICA' THEN 'retifica_pura' END
       ) AS motivos
  FROM producao
 WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO','ENDS')
   AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {{ Math.max(30, Math.min(parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.max_age_days) || 365), 10), 3650)) }} DAY))
   AND (
        queima = 'S'
     OR (usinagem = 'SIM' AND (usinafinal IS NULL OR usinafinal != 'F'))
     OR (usi_ter  = 'S'   AND (usi_stat   IS NULL OR usi_stat   != 'F'))
     OR (bl = 'S' AND NOT (bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') AND (blfim IS NULL OR blfim != 'F'))
     OR UPPER(mat) = 'RETIFICA'
   )
 ORDER BY COALESCE(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(prazo, dt_entrega), CURDATE()),9999) ASC, pedido ASC
 LIMIT {{ Math.max(1, Math.min(parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.limit) || 200), 10), 500)) }};

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT formulacao, MAX(dt) AS max_dt
    FROM quimicadb.matprima
   WHERE CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(saldo,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3)) > 0
   GROUP BY formulacao
),
prod_cores AS (
  SELECT UPPER(mat) AS mat_u, d, da,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(cor)))=1 THEN MAX(UPPER(TRIM(cor))) ELSE NULL END AS cor_unica,
         GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(cor)) ORDER BY cor SEPARATOR ',') AS cores_vistas
    FROM producaodb.producao
   WHERE cor IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cor) <> ''
     AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 730 DAY))
   GROUP BY UPPER(mat), d, da
)
SELECT m.formulacao,
       MAX(m.mat)   AS mat,
       MAX(f.d1)    AS d1,
       MAX(f.d2)    AS d2,
       MAX(pc.cor_unica)   AS cor,
       MAX(pc.cores_vistas) AS cores_vistas,
       ROUND(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(m.saldo,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3))),2) AS saldo_total,
       MAX(m.dt)    AS dt_ultimo,
       MIN(m.dt)    AS dt_mais_antigo,
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MIN(m.dt)) AS dias_em_estoque,
       COUNT(*)     AS qtd_lotes
  FROM quimicadb.matprima m
  INNER JOIN latest
    ON latest.formulacao = m.formulacao
   AND m.dt = latest.max_dt
  LEFT JOIN quimicadb.formula f ON f.id_f = m.id_f AND f.nf = 'X'
  LEFT JOIN prod_cores pc ON pc.mat_u = UPPER(m.mat) AND pc.d = f.d1 AND pc.da = f.d2
 WHERE CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(m.saldo,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3)) > 0
   AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.mat) ? ("UPPER(m.mat) LIKE '%" + String($json.body.mat).toUpperCase().replace(/'/g, '') + "%'") : '1=1' }})
 GROUP BY m.formulacao
 ORDER BY saldo_total DESC
 LIMIT 300;

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM producao
     WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
       AND (queima IS NULL OR queima IN ('N',''))
       AND ((usinagem IS NULL) OR usinagem NOT IN ('SIM') OR usinafinal = 'F')
       AND ((usi_ter IS NULL) OR usi_ter != 'S' OR usi_stat = 'F')
       AND ( (bl IS NULL OR bl IN ('','N')) OR blfim = 'F' OR (bl = 'S' AND bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') )
       AND UPPER(mat) != 'RETIFICA'
       AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY))) AS pedidos_elegiveis,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(mat,'-',d,'-',da,'-',COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(cor),''),''),'-',COALESCE(puliq,0))) FROM producao
     WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
       AND (queima IS NULL OR queima IN ('N',''))
       AND ((usinagem IS NULL) OR usinagem NOT IN ('SIM') OR usinafinal = 'F')
       AND ((usi_ter IS NULL) OR usi_ter != 'S' OR usi_stat = 'F')
       AND ( (bl IS NULL OR bl IN ('','N')) OR blfim = 'F' OR (bl = 'S' AND bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') )
       AND UPPER(mat) != 'RETIFICA'
       AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY))) AS formulacoes_distintas,
  (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(kt,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3))),0) FROM producao
     WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
       AND (queima IS NULL OR queima IN ('N',''))
       AND ((usinagem IS NULL) OR usinagem NOT IN ('SIM') OR usinafinal = 'F')
       AND ((usi_ter IS NULL) OR usi_ter != 'S' OR usi_stat = 'F')
       AND ( (bl IS NULL OR bl IN ('','N')) OR blfim = 'F' OR (bl = 'S' AND bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') )
       AND UPPER(mat) != 'RETIFICA'
       AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY))) AS kg_total,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM producao
     WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO','ENDS')
       AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY))
       AND (
            queima = 'S'
         OR (usinagem = 'SIM' AND (usinafinal IS NULL OR usinafinal != 'F'))
         OR (usi_ter  = 'S'   AND (usi_stat   IS NULL OR usi_stat   != 'F'))
         OR (bl = 'S' AND NOT (bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') AND (blfim IS NULL OR blfim != 'F'))
         OR UPPER(mat) = 'RETIFICA'
       )) AS bloqueados,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM producao
     WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
       AND UPPER(COALESCE(urgente,'N')) = 'S'
       AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY))) AS urgentes,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM producao
     WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
       AND (queima IS NULL OR queima IN ('N',''))
       AND ((usinagem IS NULL) OR usinagem NOT IN ('SIM') OR usinafinal = 'F')
       AND ((usi_ter IS NULL) OR usi_ter != 'S' OR usi_stat = 'F')
       AND ( (bl IS NULL OR bl IN ('','N')) OR blfim = 'F' OR (bl = 'S' AND bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') )
       AND UPPER(mat) != 'RETIFICA'
       AND COALESCE(prazo, dt_entrega) < CURDATE()
       AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY))) AS atrasados,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM producao
     WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
       AND bl='S' AND bl_desba='S' AND blpr='S'
       AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 365 DAY))) AS retorno_bal,
  NOW() AS gerado_em;
SELECT band_code, band_min, band_max FROM rubbercity_durometer_band ORDER BY band_min ASC;

WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT mat, d, da, NULLIF(TRIM(cor),'') AS cor, COALESCE(puliq,0) AS puliq,
         ROUND(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(kt,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3))),2) AS kt_total,
         COUNT(*) AS qtd_pedidos,
         GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ped_mestre ORDER BY ped_mestre SEPARATOR ',') AS ped_mestres,
         GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT idcli ORDER BY idcli SEPARATOR ',') AS idclis,
         SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT idcli ORDER BY idcli SEPARATOR ','),',',1) AS idcli_principal,
         MIN(pedido) AS primeiro_pedido,
         MAX(pedido) AS ultimo_pedido,
         MAX(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(urgente,'N'))='S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tem_urgente,
         MAX(CASE WHEN bl='S' AND bl_desba='S' AND blpr='S' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tem_retorno_bal,
         MIN(COALESCE(prazo, dt_entrega)) AS sla_min,
         MIN(prazo) AS prazo_min,
         MIN(dt_entrega) AS dt_entrega_min,
         MIN(dt_entra) AS dt_entra_min
    FROM producao
   WHERE status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
     AND (queima IS NULL OR queima IN ('N',''))
     AND ((usinagem IS NULL) OR usinagem NOT IN ('SIM') OR usinafinal = 'F')
     AND ((usi_ter IS NULL) OR usi_ter != 'S' OR usi_stat = 'F')
     AND ( (bl IS NULL OR bl IN ('','N')) OR blfim = 'F' OR (bl = 'S' AND bl_desba = 'S' AND blpr = 'S') )
     AND UPPER(mat) != 'RETIFICA'
     AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {{ Math.max(30, Math.min(parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.max_age_days) || 365), 10), 3650)) }} DAY))
     AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.customer_filter) ? ("(UPPER(pedido) LIKE '%" + String($json.body.customer_filter).toUpperCase().replace(/'/g, '') + "%' OR idcli = '" + String($json.body.customer_filter).replace(/'/g, '') + "')") : '1=1' }})
     AND ({{ ($json.body && $json.body.family_filter) ? ("UPPER(mat) LIKE '%" + String($json.body.family_filter).toUpperCase().replace(/'/g, '') + "%'") : '1=1' }})
   GROUP BY mat, d, da, NULLIF(TRIM(cor),''), COALESCE(puliq,0)
),
stock_latest AS (
  SELECT m.formulacao,
         ROUND(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(m.saldo,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3))),2) AS saldo_total
    FROM quimicadb.matprima m
    INNER JOIN (
      SELECT formulacao, MAX(dt) AS max_dt
        FROM quimicadb.matprima
       WHERE CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(saldo,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3)) > 0
       GROUP BY formulacao
    ) latest ON latest.formulacao = m.formulacao AND m.dt = latest.max_dt
   WHERE CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(m.saldo,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3)) > 0
   GROUP BY m.formulacao
),
matches AS (
  SELECT g.mat AS g_mat, g.d AS g_d, g.da AS g_da, g.cor AS g_cor, g.puliq AS g_puliq,
         ff.id_f, ff.formulacao,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY g.mat, g.d, g.da, g.cor, g.puliq
           ORDER BY (ff.d1 = g.d AND ff.d2 = g.da) DESC,
                    (ff.d1 = g.d) DESC,
                    ABS(ff.d1 - g.d) ASC,
                    ABS(COALESCE(ff.d2, ff.d1) - COALESCE(NULLIF(g.da,0), g.d)) ASC,
                    ff.d2 ASC,
                    ff.id_f ASC
         ) AS rn
    FROM grouped g
    JOIN quimicadb.formula ff
      ON ff.nf = 'X'
     AND UPPER(ff.mat) = (CASE WHEN 1=0 THEN '' {{ ($('Get family aliases (ofm)').all() || []).map(i => "WHEN UPPER('" + String(i.json.producao_mat || '').replace(/'/g, '') + "')=UPPER(g.mat) THEN UPPER('" + String(i.json.formula_mat || '').replace(/'/g, '') + "')").join(' ') }} ELSE UPPER(g.mat) END)
     AND ff.d1 BETWEEN ({{ ((b)=>b.length?'CASE '+b.map(x=>'WHEN g.d BETWEEN '+x.json.band_min+' AND '+x.json.band_max+' AND (g.da IS NULL OR g.da=0 OR g.da BETWEEN '+x.json.band_min+' AND '+x.json.band_max+') THEN '+x.json.band_min).join(' ')+' ELSE g.d END':'g.d')($('Get durometer bands (ofm)').all()||[]) }}) AND ({{ ((b)=>b.length?'CASE '+b.map(x=>'WHEN g.d BETWEEN '+x.json.band_min+' AND '+x.json.band_max+' AND (g.da IS NULL OR g.da=0 OR g.da BETWEEN '+x.json.band_min+' AND '+x.json.band_max+') THEN '+x.json.band_max).join(' ')+' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(g.da,0),g.d) END':'COALESCE(NULLIF(g.da,0),g.d)')($('Get durometer bands (ofm)').all()||[]) }})
     AND (
       g.da IS NULL
       OR g.da = 0
       OR ff.d2 IS NULL
       OR ff.d2 BETWEEN ({{ ((b)=>b.length?'CASE '+b.map(x=>'WHEN g.d BETWEEN '+x.json.band_min+' AND '+x.json.band_max+' AND (g.da IS NULL OR g.da=0 OR g.da BETWEEN '+x.json.band_min+' AND '+x.json.band_max+') THEN '+x.json.band_min).join(' ')+' ELSE g.d END':'g.d')($('Get durometer bands (ofm)').all()||[]) }}) AND ({{ ((b)=>b.length?'CASE '+b.map(x=>'WHEN g.d BETWEEN '+x.json.band_min+' AND '+x.json.band_max+' AND (g.da IS NULL OR g.da=0 OR g.da BETWEEN '+x.json.band_min+' AND '+x.json.band_max+') THEN '+x.json.band_max).join(' ')+' ELSE COALESCE(NULLIF(g.da,0),g.d) END':'COALESCE(NULLIF(g.da,0),g.d)')($('Get durometer bands (ofm)').all()||[]) }})
     )
),
enriched AS (
  SELECT g.*,
         f.id_f AS codigo_formula,
         f.formulacao AS formulacao_oficial,
         COALESCE(s.saldo_total, 0) AS saldo_estoque,
         CASE
           WHEN UPPER(g.mat)='AG' AND g.d=20 AND g.da=25 AND UPPER(g.cor)='PRETA' THEN 90
           WHEN UPPER(g.mat)='AG' AND g.d=25 AND g.da=28 AND UPPER(g.cor)='PRETA' THEN 90
           WHEN UPPER(g.mat)='AG' AND g.d=30 AND g.da=33 AND UPPER(g.cor)='PRETA' THEN 90
           WHEN UPPER(g.mat)='AG' AND g.d=35 AND g.da=40 AND UPPER(g.cor)='PRETA' THEN 30
           ELSE 0
         END AS piso_estoque,
         CASE WHEN g.da IS NOT NULL AND g.da >= 60 THEN 0.08 ELSE 0.07 END AS margem,
         DATEDIFF(g.sla_min, CURDATE()) AS dias_sla,
         DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), g.dt_entra_min) AS dias_em_casa
    FROM grouped g
    LEFT JOIN matches f
      ON f.rn = 1
     AND f.g_mat <=> g.mat
     AND f.g_d  <=> g.d
     AND f.g_da <=> g.da
     AND f.g_cor <=> g.cor
     AND f.g_puliq <=> g.puliq
    LEFT JOIN stock_latest s ON s.formulacao = f.formulacao
),
final AS (
  SELECT *,
         GREATEST(saldo_estoque - piso_estoque, 0) AS saldo_disponivel,
         ROUND(kt_total * (1 + margem), 1) AS kg_necessario,
         CASE
           WHEN tem_urgente = 1 THEN 'URGENTE'
           WHEN sla_min IS NULL THEN CASE WHEN tem_retorno_bal = 1 THEN 'RETORNO_BAL' ELSE 'SEM_SLA' END
           WHEN DATEDIFF(sla_min, CURDATE()) < 0 THEN 'ATRASADO'
           WHEN tem_retorno_bal = 1 THEN 'RETORNO_BAL'
           WHEN DATEDIFF(sla_min, CURDATE()) <= 3 THEN 'SLA_3D'
           WHEN DATEDIFF(sla_min, CURDATE()) <= 7 THEN 'SLA_7D'
           ELSE 'NORMAL'
         END AS prioridade,
         CASE
           WHEN formulacao_oficial IS NULL THEN 'pendente'
           WHEN kt_total IS NULL OR kt_total <= 0 THEN 'pendente'
           WHEN GREATEST(saldo_estoque - piso_estoque, 0) >= kt_total * (1 + margem) THEN 'consumir'
           ELSE 'criar'
         END AS decisao
    FROM enriched
)
SELECT mat, d, da, cor, puliq, kt_total, qtd_pedidos, ped_mestres, idclis, idcli_principal,
       primeiro_pedido, ultimo_pedido, sla_min, prazo_min, dt_entrega_min,
       dt_entra_min, dias_sla, dias_em_casa, tem_urgente, tem_retorno_bal,
       codigo_formula, formulacao_oficial, saldo_estoque, piso_estoque, margem,
       saldo_disponivel, kg_necessario,
       CASE decisao
         WHEN 'criar' THEN ROUND(GREATEST(kg_necessario - saldo_disponivel, kg_necessario), 1)
         ELSE 0
       END AS kg_ofm_sugerido,
       decisao,
       prioridade,
       CASE
         WHEN decisao = 'pendente' AND formulacao_oficial IS NULL
           THEN CONCAT('Sem formula oficial em quimicadb.formula compativel com mat=', mat, ', d=', d, ', da=', COALESCE(da,0), ' (nf=X, considerando as faixas oficiais de dureza). Verifique a faixa do pedido ou cadastre alias em rubbercity_durometer_alias â€” use lookup_formula para conferir.')
         WHEN decisao = 'pendente'
           THEN 'kt_total zerado no ERP â€” validar peso antes de gerar OFM.'
         ELSE NULL
       END AS motivo_pendente,
       CONCAT(
         'Necessario: ', ROUND(kt_total,1), ' kg x (1+', ROUND(margem*100), '%) = ', ROUND(kg_necessario,1), ' kg. ',
         'Saldo: ', ROUND(saldo_estoque,1), ' kg',
         CASE WHEN piso_estoque > 0 THEN CONCAT(' (piso ', piso_estoque, ' kg -> disponivel ', ROUND(saldo_disponivel,1), ' kg)') ELSE '' END,
         '. ',
         CASE decisao
           WHEN 'consumir' THEN 'Saldo cobre a necessidade -> consumir estoque, sem OFM.'
           WHEN 'criar'    THEN CONCAT('Saldo cobre ', ROUND(saldo_disponivel,1), ' kg; faltam ', ROUND(GREATEST(kg_necessario - saldo_disponivel, 0),1), ' kg -> criar OFM.')
           WHEN 'pendente' THEN 'Falta dado critico â€” ver motivo ao lado.'
         END,
         CASE
           WHEN dias_sla IS NULL THEN ' Sem prazo no ERP.'
           WHEN dias_sla < 0 THEN CONCAT(' SLA estourado ha ', ABS(dias_sla), ' dia(s).')
           ELSE CONCAT(' SLA em ', dias_sla, ' dia(s).')
         END,
         CASE WHEN tem_urgente = 1 THEN ' [URGENTE]' ELSE '' END,
         CASE WHEN tem_retorno_bal = 1 THEN ' [retorno balanceamento -> JATO]' ELSE '' END,
         CASE WHEN dt_entra_min IS NOT NULL THEN CONCAT(' Rolo mais antigo: ', DATE_FORMAT(dt_entra_min,'%d/%m/%Y'), ' (', dias_em_casa, ' dia(s) em casa).') ELSE '' END
       ) AS como_calculado
  FROM final
 ORDER BY
   FIELD(prioridade,'URGENTE','ATRASADO','RETORNO_BAL','SLA_3D','SLA_7D','NORMAL','SEM_SLA'),
   FIELD(decisao,'criar','consumir','pendente'),
   COALESCE(dias_sla, 9999) ASC,
   kt_total DESC
 LIMIT 200;

WITH latest AS (
  SELECT formulacao, MAX(dt) AS max_dt, MIN(dt) AS min_dt
    FROM quimicadb.matprima
   WHERE CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(saldo,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3)) > 0
   GROUP BY formulacao
),
prod_cores AS (
  SELECT UPPER(mat) AS mat_u, d, da,
         CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(cor)))=1 THEN MAX(UPPER(TRIM(cor))) ELSE NULL END AS cor_unica,
         GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT UPPER(TRIM(cor)) ORDER BY cor SEPARATOR ',') AS cores_vistas
    FROM producaodb.producao
   WHERE cor IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cor) <> ''
     AND (dt_entra IS NULL OR dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 730 DAY))
   GROUP BY UPPER(mat), d, da
),
demanda_match AS (
  SELECT f.formulacao,
         GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.pedido ORDER BY p.pedido SEPARATOR ',') AS pedidos_sample,
         GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(p.mat,' ',p.d,'/',COALESCE(p.da,0),' ',COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.cor),''),'-')) ORDER BY p.mat SEPARATOR ' | ') AS combinacoes_sample,
         COUNT(*) AS pedidos_match
    FROM producaodb.producao p
    JOIN quimicadb.formula f
      ON f.id_f = (
        SELECT ff.id_f FROM quimicadb.formula ff
         WHERE ff.nf = 'X'
           AND UPPER(ff.mat) = (CASE WHEN 1=0 THEN '' {{ ($('Get family aliases (orphan)').all() || []).map(i => "WHEN UPPER('" + String(i.json.producao_mat || '').replace(/'/g, '') + "')=UPPER(p.mat) THEN UPPER('" + String(i.json.formula_mat || '').replace(/'/g, '') + "')").join(' ') }} ELSE UPPER(p.mat) END)
           AND ff.d1 = p.d
           AND (
             ff.d2 = p.da
             OR p.da IS NULL
             OR p.da = 0
           )
         ORDER BY (ff.d2 = p.da) DESC,
                  ABS(COALESCE(ff.d2, ff.d1) - COALESCE(NULLIF(p.da,0), p.d)) ASC,
                  ff.d2 ASC
         LIMIT 1
      )
   WHERE p.status IN ('LIMPEZA','LIMPEZAI','JATO')
     AND (p.queima IS NULL OR p.queima IN ('N',''))
     AND ((p.usinagem IS NULL) OR p.usinagem NOT IN ('SIM') OR p.usinafinal = 'F')
     AND ((p.usi_ter IS NULL) OR p.usi_ter != 'S' OR p.usi_stat = 'F')
     AND ( (p.bl IS NULL OR p.bl IN ('','N')) OR p.blfim = 'F' OR (p.bl = 'S' AND p.bl_desba = 'S' AND p.blpr = 'S') )
     AND UPPER(p.mat) != 'RETIFICA'
     AND (p.dt_entra IS NULL OR p.dt_entra >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL {{ Math.max(30, Math.min(parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.max_age_days) || 365), 10), 3650)) }} DAY))
   GROUP BY f.formulacao
)
SELECT m.formulacao,
       MAX(m.mat) AS mat,
       MAX(f.d1)  AS d1,
       MAX(f.d2)  AS d2,
       MAX(pc.cor_unica)   AS cor,
       MAX(pc.cores_vistas) AS cores_vistas,
       ROUND(SUM(CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(m.saldo,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3))),2) AS saldo_kg,
       MAX(l.max_dt) AS dt_ultimo,
       MIN(l.min_dt) AS dt_mais_antigo,
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MIN(l.min_dt)) AS dias_em_estoque,
       COUNT(*) AS qtd_lotes,
       CASE WHEN dm.formulacao IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS tem_demanda,
       dm.pedidos_match    AS pedidos_match,
       dm.pedidos_sample   AS pedidos_sample,
       dm.combinacoes_sample AS combinacoes_sample
  FROM quimicadb.matprima m
  JOIN latest l ON l.formulacao = m.formulacao AND m.dt = l.max_dt
  LEFT JOIN quimicadb.formula f ON f.id_f = m.id_f AND f.nf = 'X'
  LEFT JOIN prod_cores pc ON pc.mat_u = UPPER(m.mat) AND pc.d = f.d1 AND pc.da = f.d2
  LEFT JOIN demanda_match dm ON dm.formulacao = m.formulacao
 WHERE CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(COALESCE(m.saldo,'0'),',','.'),' ','') AS DECIMAL(12,3)) > 0
   AND ( {{ (($json.body && parseInt($json.body.debug,10)) || 0) }} = 1 OR dm.formulacao IS NULL )
 GROUP BY m.formulacao, dm.formulacao, dm.pedidos_match, dm.pedidos_sample, dm.combinacoes_sample
 ORDER BY tem_demanda ASC, saldo_kg DESC
 LIMIT {{ Math.max(1, Math.min(parseInt((($json.body && $json.body.limit) || 200), 10), 1000)) }};
